days.name: Tamatea-āio
days.description: Time to be cautious - the unpredictable can happen. Avoid hui at this time. Stay close to whānau. Take notice.

days.name: Tamatea-angana
days.description: Time to be cautious, avoid hui and offer your support to whānau or those who need your tautoko.

days.name: Tamatea-kai-ariki
days.description: Time to be cautious, avoid hui and offer your support to whānau or those who need your tautoko.

days.name: Tamatea Tuhāhā
days.description: Be cautious. Unpredictable time. A good time for taking notice, keeping learning and giving back.

days.name: Ariroa
days.description: An unproductive time, bringing opportunities to be still, reflect and take notice. Be cautious, and look for ways to keep learning.

days.name: Huna
days.description: Giveback day for Tangaroa. A good time for self care, nourishing your hinengaro, wairua, and tinana.

days.name: Māwharu
days.description: Use your energy in productive ways that will bring great results for you in the future. Be active. Take notice.

days.name: Ōhua
days.description: Reflect, retract and stay close to whānau. A good time for learning, taking notice, being present and planning for the future.

days.name: Atua Whakahaehae
days.description: A good day for being mindful, taking notice of the world around us and reducing the harm towards our natural environment.

days.name: Turu
days.description: Great time to plan for the times ahead. Make the most of this high productivity time. Be active, support others where you can.

days.name: Te Rākaunui
days.description: Full Moon - A good time to be productive or active, set short term goals, have people over or plan a special occasion.

days.name: Rākaumatohi
days.description: A productive day for completing mahi, getting things done and starting new projects. Be active or connect with whānau.

days.name: Takirau
days.description: Slow down, relax, rest, renew. Take notice. A good day for strategic planning. Find time to connect with te taiao (nature).

days.name: Oike
days.description: Rest to maximise time ahead. Be mindful, notice the world around you, and manage your time. Come up with ways to give back.

days.name: Korekore Tuatahi
days.description: Good time to rest, fast, spend time with whānau, support those in need, be creative and practise mindfulness, nohopuku.

days.name: Korekore Rawea
days.description: Good time to rest, fast, spend time with whānau, support those in need, be creative and practise mindfulness, nohopuku.

days.name: Korekore Whakapiri
days.description: Good time for wānanga, creativity, planning ahead, and being close to Tangaroa. Observe the sea and its healing energy.

days.name: Tangaroa-ā-mua
days.description: An ideal time for team events or for doing things with your whānau, friends and community. Kōrero, connect and share ideas.

days.name: Tangaroa-ā-roto
days.description: A great phase for fishing, water activities and romiromi (massage). Be sure to drink lots of water to stay hydrated.

days.name: Tangaroa-whakapau
days.description: A great time to get the creative juices flowing, challenge yourself physically, or enjoy your favourite water activities.

days.name: Tangaroa Whāriki Kiokio
days.description: Surging energy. Make the most of these productive times. Be active, take notice and find ways to give back.

days.name: Ōrongonui
days.description: Productive time physically and emotionally. Personal development and positive vibes are apparent at this time.

days.name: Ōmutu
days.description: Energy is slowing. A good time for karakia, whakapapa, resting, fasting or planning for the time ahead. Recharge. Be mindful.

days.name: Mutuwhenua
days.description: Give yourself a treat, mirimiri or hair cut something you can enjoy. Nurture your wairua, tinana, hinengaro and whānau.

days.name: Whiro-Pipiri
days.description: New Moon - time for rest, reflection, and setting new intentions. Stay close to whānau, self-reflect, plan ahead.

days.name: Tirea
days.description: Make time for loved ones, enjoy downtime. Time to reflect and recharge.

days.name: Hoata
days.description: Good time to plant seedlings and all areas of planting, seek knowledge to sustain whānau. Be active, keep learning.

days.name: Ōuenuku
days.description: Make time to explore te taiao or near water. Good time to connect with others, learn and share karakia or pepeha.

days.name: Okoro
days.description: Communication and creativity flowing. Try something new. A day to appreciate life. Spend time with whānau.

days.name: Tamatea-āio
days.description: Time to be cautious - the unpredictable can happen. Avoid hui at this time. Stay close to whānau. Take notice.

seed.meaning: By regularly nurturing your new whakaaro, they will grow and guide your actions

takitini.textMi: Ehara taku toa i te toa takitahi, engari he toa takitini
takitini.textEn: My strength is not that of a single warrior but that of many
takitini.meaning: Success comes from the combined efforts of many, not just individual achievement; emphasizes unity and collective power. The completion of work, especially big projects, requires persistent collective effort from all involved. An open, inclusive mindset embraces collective support and shared responsibility for psychological wellbeing.

journalExamples.intentionsWairua: Today I want to spend 10 minutes in meditation to connect with my inner self and reflect on my values.
journalExamples.intentionsTinana: I plan to go for a 30-minute walk this morning and prepare a healthy lunch with vegetables.
journalExamples.intentionsWhanau: I want to call my parents this evening and spend quality time with my children after work.
journalExamples.intentionsHinengaro: Today I will focus on learning a new skill and managing my stress through breathing exercises.
journalExamples.intentionsWhenua: I intend to spend time in the garden and take a mindful walk in the park this afternoon.
journalExamples.gratitude: I am grateful for my supportive family and the beautiful sunrise I witnessed this morning.
journalExamples.financialReflections: Yesterday I made a conscious decision to save money by cooking at home instead of eating out.
journalExamples.content: Today was a meaningful day. I felt connected to my purpose and grateful for the journey.
journalExamples.kumeteContribution: Today I contributed by mentoring a colleague and volunteering at the local food bank.
journalExamples.kumeteOverflow: I received amazing support from my team who helped me complete a difficult project.
journalExamples.prideToday: I am proud that I completed my presentation despite feeling nervous, and it was well-received.
journalExamples.highlightToday: The highlight was having lunch with my best friend and laughing together about old memories.
journalExamples.helpedWho: I helped my neighbor carry groceries and mentored a junior team member through a challenging task.
journalExamples.acknowledgeLearnRelease: I acknowledge that I was impatient today. I learned that I need to take breaks when stressed, and I release the frustration I felt.
journalExamples.tomorrowGoals: Tomorrow: 1) Start the day with meditation, 2) Complete the budget report, 3) Call my parents in the evening.
journalExamples.feelingNow: Right now I feel peaceful and content, ready to rest and recharge for tomorrow.
